v.rationale: All three suites pass and share one bug: public filter validation sends users back to the previous URL, and a repeated visit to a bad URL loops. impl-2 is the most complete and idiomatic Blade solution. It has a full set of small form components with @error, old() and @selected/@checked, a sort enum that applies its own ordering, escaped LIKE search, slug normalisation and the strongest Pest tests with datasets. Its only blemishes are reusing the viewAny policy method and building sort options in the view. impl-3 is close behind: a proper form component, a global pagination view, a careful dollars-to-cents conversion and visible filter errors. It loses ground for an awkward type-switching field component, a manual slug lookup and thinner tests. impl-1 ranks last because of a real search bug (unescaped whereLike wildcards, so '%' matches everything), slugs that keep their capitals, an enum and request() calls in the view, @props inside an included partial and inline styles.
